questions.question: What happened when Simon Peter obeyed Jesus and let down his nets?
options: They enclosed a great multitude of fish
They toiled all night and caught nothing
A sudden storm rose up against them
They caught a single enormous fish
questions.answer: They enclosed a great multitude of fish
